FUM and FUH — HEDIS follow-up

CDPHP asked
30-day

FUM is follow-up after an ED visit for mental illness; FUH is follow-up after hospitalisation. Both use the completed-visit date, not the booking date.

FUHFUM

Acuity 4 criteria — appendix

CDPHP asked

Send as an attachment with any acuity figure. A member meets acuity 4 on any one of these.

  1. Discharge from inpatient behavioural health or an ED behavioural health presentation in the last 30 days
  2. Active suicidal ideation, a plan, or self-harm within the last 30 days
  3. PHQ-9 of 20 or above, or GAD-7 of 15 or above, at intake
  4. Two or more behavioural health crisis contacts in the last 90 days
  5. Co-occurring substance use requiring concurrent treatment
  6. Clinician override with a documented reason
